# Entity relationship diagrams (live)

<!-- GENERATED by AA-CIS-Infra db/gen_erd.py (infra/AA-CIS-Infra/.github/workflows/db-schema-dump.yml) - do not edit -->

One generated Mermaid `erDiagram` per schema of the shared RDS, from the same live catalog dump as the [DB schema reference](../db-schema-reference.md). Newest migration per owner: Booking **bk-029**, CIS **290**, TripPlanner **tp-020**. The DB Schema Dump workflow regenerates these pages after every DB Migrate apply and every night and opens a root PR when the structure changed, so a new or dropped foreign key shows up as a diff here. Hand-written design diagrams (AA-894 scope 3) go to `design/` next to these pages, never into them.

### Between two owners

A foreign key from one owner's schema to another's is a finding of the RLS catalogue guard (rule e) unless it is on the guard's allowlist (see the DB schema reference).

None.

## Machine-readable model

The DB Schema Dump run also writes `erd.json` (schemas, tables, columns with full types, PK, unique keys, FKs, DM-6.1 tags, owner; no row data) as a run artifact, the input of the CIS admin data-model view (AA-894 scope 2).
